content: poe.ninja aggregates from a single authoritative low-latency public API (GGG stash tab feed), applies statistical outlier filtering (not simple average) to exclude price-fixed/artificial listings before computing a 'confident' price, refreshes every 5-15 min, and serves via HTTP-cached (ETag) endpoints. Key transferable lesson: raw marketplace data always needs an outlier-filtering/statistical layer before being shown as 'the price', not a raw mean/median of all matched listings.
